items.title: Magicians：ERC 链上明文签名
items.note: （nail）07:34：Kampela 制作隔离式硬件签名设备，提议让交易在受限设备上也能以人类可读形式核验，无需可信第三方；如今以太坊普遍是盲签，用户只能相信请求方对交易的描述。
items.note_en: (nail), 07:34: Kampela, which builds air gapped hardware signers, proposes making transactions human readable and verifiable on constrained devices without trusted third parties; today Ethereum relies on blind signing, where users must trust the requesting app's description.

keywords_en: EIP-8141 breakout #2 on transaction pool strategies
EIP-8184 top of block competition update
summary_en: The second EIP-8141 frame transaction breakout covered transaction pool strategies. Hardware wallet team Kampela proposed an Onchain Clear Signing ERC so constrained devices can read and verify transactions without trusted third parties. nerolation's Payload Chunking with Chunk Access Lists EIP merged. anderselowsson added a paragraph to LUCID's top of block competition section, submitted and merged.
